parameters.query:
SELECT *
FROM public.ingest_provider_donation(
  p_provider => 'givebutter',
  p_provider_reference => $2,
  p_amount_cents => $3,
  p_currency => COALESCE($4, 'USD'),
  p_donated_at => CASE WHEN $5 IS NULL OR $5 = '' THEN NULL ELSE $5::timestamptz END,
  p_notes => $6,
  p_raw => $7::jsonb,
  p_email => $1,
  p_phone => $10,
  p_provider_identity => $12
);
